f3_program: collection("company.revenue.by_customer_headquarters_location.2019", "revenue", "customer_headquarters", source("Revenue based on the geographic location of our customer's headquarters was as follows:"))

partition("company.revenue.by_customer_headquarters_location.2019", at("company.revenue.total", "2019"), source("Revenue based on the geographic location of our customer's headquarters was as follows:"))
partition("company.revenue.taiwan_and_japan.2019", at("company.revenue.taiwan_and_japan.total", "2019"), source("total percentage of revenue from Taiwan and Japan"))
assumptions: The seven named 2019 geographic rows are treated as an exhaustive partition of total revenue; the displayed total row is not cited directly because its row label is empty.

f3_program: collection("ben.cards", "card", "ben", source("Ben has four boxes with ten basketball cards in each box"))
observe(at("ben.basketball_cards.per_box.count", "initial"), 10, "count", source("ten basketball cards in each box"))

product_relation(at("ben.cards.count", "initial"), at("ben.basketball_card_boxes.count", "initial"), at("ben.basketball_cards.per_box.count", "initial"), source("Ben has four boxes with ten basketball cards in each box"))

product_relation(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.count", "current"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_card_boxes.count", "current"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.per_box.count", "current"), source("five boxes with eight baseball cards"))

add("mother_gives_baseball_cards", "ben.mother", at("ben.cards.count", "current"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.count", "current"), source("His mother gave him five boxes with eight baseball cards"))
transfer("ben_gives_cards_to_classmates", "ben", at("ben.cards.count", "current"), "classmates.cards", 58, source("he gives 58 cards to his classmates"))
assumptions: By parallelism with the preceding phrase "in each box," each of the five gifted boxes is interpreted as containing eight baseball cards.

f3_program: collection("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", "patron", "overflow_lot", source("There are 12 patrons who came in cars and 27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
observe(at("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.from_cars.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
observe(at("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.from_bus.count", "current"), 27, "count", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
member("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", "overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.from_cars", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
member("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", "overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.from_bus", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
partition("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", at("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.count", "current"), source("There are 12 patrons who came in cars and 27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
observe(at("golf_cart.patron_capacity", "current"), 3, "count", source("Ellen can fit 3 patrons in a golf cart"))

transfer("ellen_transports_waiting_patrons", "ellen", "overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", "main_lot.patrons", at("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.count", "current"), source("She must transport the patrons who parked in the overflow lot up to the main lot using a golf cart"))

product_relation(at("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.count", "current"), at("ellen.transport.required_golf_carts.count", "current"), at("golf_cart.patron_capacity", "current"), source("She must transport the patrons who parked in the overflow lot up to the main lot using a golf cart. Ellen can fit 3 patrons in a golf cart"))
assumptions: All patrons in the two waiting groups are interpreted as the patrons Ellen must transport.
Each required cart represents one cart-load, and carts are assumed to be filled to the stated capacity.
